rule: Pink revelation AFTER Kaia's philosophical breakthrough. Do not claim Kaia beat Pink by raw power.

beats.speaker: kaia
beats.line: Gray was never meant to erase them. Only to understand why they could not be forced.
beats.note: Philosophical breakthrough — not a power victory over Pink.

beats.speaker: rosamere
beats.line: I did not make them to be conquered. I made them so someone could choose.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.line: Above Yin and Yang, Primordial Pink grants permission — not domination.
